why_navier_now.step_change: Hydrofoiling lifts the hull clear of the water, so a Navier vessel flies instead of plowing through chop - roughly 10x more efficient than a conventional planing boat, faster (30+ kt cruise), and dramatically smoother and quieter. It's software-defined and autonomy-ready, so the same fleet keeps getting better and cheaper to run over time. A step-change in marine mobility, not an incremental faster boat.
why_navier_now.no_new_infrastructure: Navier rides on infrastructure that already exists - the open ocean and the berths and jetties already in use. No vertiports, no new rights-of-way, no tunnels or tracks. Pioneer II needs only a berth pedestal; the Quanta-LR hybrid needs no charging infrastructure at all. That's the fundamental contrast with flying taxis and other new-infrastructure modes: nothing to permit, build, or wait for.
why_navier_now.the_moment: The Maldives foiling network is already live and phasing; Soneva can be its luxury flagship while extending the same standard to Thailand.

end_state.headline: A silent foiling transfer tier across all of Soneva.

network_thesis.headline: The arrival, reinvented — across every Soneva island.
network_thesis.body: Soneva built a brand on slow, sensory, sustainable luxury — yet the boat transfer that bookends every stay is still diesel speedboats and weather-bound seaplanes. The same silent foiling transfer plugs into the live Maldives network at Soneva Fushi, Jani and Secret, and extends to Soneva Kiri in Thailand — turning the most-remembered moments of the journey into signature, zero-emission Soneva experiences.
network_thesis.coverage_note: Soneva operates a small, intensely curated collection — the Maldives flagship and Soneva Kiri in Thailand. These are the two islands where the silent over-water arrival transforms the guest journey today; the same fleet extends to any future Soneva island.

markets.label: Maldives
markets.summary: Soneva Fushi, Soneva Jani and Soneva Secret are the Maldives' most celebrated barefoot-luxury resorts — and the boat transfer is the first and last impression of the stay. Today that's a diesel speedboat or a costly, daylight-only seaplane. A silent foiling transfer turns the journey itself into part of the Soneva experience.

hero.what_we_do_together: Soneva brings the world's most discerning resort guests and a brand built on slow, sensory luxury; Navier brings the silent zero-wake foiling transfer that makes the over-water journey a highlight rather than a diesel-and-spray ordeal.

partner_context.their_pressure: Guest arrival depends on diesel speedboats (rough, noisy, fuel-smelling) or seaplanes (expensive, daylight-only, weather-limited) — a jarring contrast with the serenity guests pay for, and a sustainability liability.
partner_context.where_navier_fits: A silent, zero-emission, zero-wake foiling transfer that runs after dark and in swell — turning the most-remembered moments of the stay (arrival and departure) into a signature, on-brand experience.

markets.why_now: Soneva's flagship resorts in Baa and Noonu atolls are reached today by seaplane or speedboat; the foiling transfer slots in as a premium, all-weather, after-dark alternative that aligns with Soneva Unlimited's sustainability commitments.

That's the fundamental contrast with flying taxis and other new-infrastructure modes: nothing to permit, build, or wait for.

objections.response: For the longest hops seaplanes keep a role, but Quanta-LR hybrid covers the flagship atolls after dark and in weather that grounds seaplanes — extending operable hours and removing the daylight constraint.

objections.concern: Our guests expect absolute discretion and calm.
objections.response: That is precisely the foiling advantage — silent, zero-wake, no diesel smell or pounding; the transfer becomes a serene extension of the resort.

objections.concern: Resort jetties vary in depth and access.
objections.response: Pioneer II needs only a berth pedestal and shallow-draft foiling approach; we survey each jetty in the pilot and tune the approach per property.

markets.label: Soneva Kiri (Eastern Gulf of Thailand)
markets.summary: Soneva Kiri sits on remote Koh Kood in the far eastern Gulf of Thailand — reached today via Soneva's own light aircraft plus a speedboat. Koh Kood has no dedicated atlas node, so it is anchored to the neighbouring Koh Rong archipelago cluster; a silent foiling transfer offers a cleaner, more flexible over-water arrival to one of Asia's most rarefied island resorts.
